notes.title: Chapter 2 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813099/2da1fc29211cca847fe7e42822eba644e2486446.png[/img]

In Chapter 2 of Grim's Gambit, players continue Nox's thrilling journey through the Stygian Keep. Following the chaotic and darkly humorous events of the coffee shop, Nox faces new challenges and uncovers deeper mysteries. As he navigates through the Stygian Keep, he must manage the bustling demands of the coffee shop, meet intriguing new characters, and investigate the hidden secrets of this eerie realm.

[h3]Play through fully interactable coffee shop, fulfilling coffee orders and the quick demands![/h3]
[list]
[*] Complete unique orders with Cream, Amphithere Blood, Sugar and Nectar!
[*] Don't forget to top off your coffee with a Chocolate, Caramel or Whip Cream Drizzle!
[*] Interact with new characters and investigate in the Stygian Keep!
[/list]

[b]Play through an [u]entirely new overhauled[/u] art implementation![/b]

[u]We have also added in full animations for all the characters currently in the game that include:[/u]
[list]
[*] Full Skulliver Emotion Animations
[*] Full Grim Emotion Animations
[*] Animated Cutscenes
[*] Animated backgrounds
[/list]

[b]Misc. Changes:[/b]

Updated Map Evidence Minigame which includes Skulliver telling the player the rearrangement of sticky note clues.
Updated and added new sections to the Gallery upon completion for chapter 2
